requirements.description: Annual Compustat firm-year inputs for Size (log total assets), Age (years with total assets reported since 1980), Cash Flow (OANCF/average total assets), two-digit SIC Industry Growth (ratio of current-year to prior-year sales), Industry fixed effects and calendar-year fixed effects. Use the original 1988–2000 study period with the required age history and current local vintage.

required_coverage.population: Compustat North American firm-years in the paper’s annual industrial/research universe that supply the controls and two-digit SIC classification; exact historical coverage and source population are not locally confirmed.
required_coverage.detail: The target firm-year sample is 1988–2000. Age counts available total-asset years since 1980, extending the earliest raw year to 1980; Cash Flow and Industry Growth use t−1 inputs, which require 1987 for the first 1988 observation. Annual fiscal-year labels and source-published 2001 vintage are not interchangeable.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: The catalog labels at as total assets, oancf as operating-activities net cash flow, sale as net sales/turnover, and sich as historical SIC. These labels support the paper’s Size, Age, Cash Flow, Industry Growth and FE input meanings; Age is reconstructed by counting firm-year asset records since 1980. No historical item-number mapping is inferred.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact fields are present in the current local file. No coordinator coverage confirmation verifies 1980–2000 population completeness; current Compustat product/vintage differs from the paper’s 2001 annual industrial and research files.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Local exact fields are readable, but there is no coordinator coverage confirmation for the paper-era Compustat population. The current local merged annual product is not verified as a complete 1980–2000 copy of the authors’ 2001 industrial/research files.

requirements.description: Firm-year current-accrual inputs: changes in current assets, cash and cash equivalents, current liabilities and short-term debt/current portion of long-term debt, scaled by average total assets; apply the source-prescribed absolute, positive, negative and raw transformations as appropriate.

required_coverage.population: Compustat North American firm-years in the paper’s annual industrial/research source population with current-accrual items and average assets; exact historical coverage is not confirmed.
required_coverage.detail: The Table 2 current-accrual observations are 1988–2000. Differences in current assets, cash, current liabilities and short-term debt require t and t−1; average total assets also uses t−1. The union of these raw dates is 1987–2000, not a two-year additive lag.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: act is labeled Current Assets—Total, lct Current Liabilities—Total, dlc Debt in Current Liabilities—Total, and at Assets—Total. che is labeled Cash and Short-Term Investments, while the paper describes change in cash and cash equivalents and cites historical Compustat item 1; without a verified vintage crosswalk, this is a material semantic mismatch and the bundle mapping remains unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact fields are present in the local file, but population coverage is unconfirmed and the current che label does not exactly match the paper’s cash wording.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation covers the 1987–2000 study population. Current che is labeled cash plus short-term investments, while the paper describes cash and cash equivalents; the campaign provides no validated historical-item crosswalk to resolve the difference.

requirements.description: Raw firm-year inputs for the supporting contemporaneous Jones model: operating income after depreciation, operating cash flow, net sales, net PP&E, total assets for average-asset scaling, fiscal year and two-digit SIC. The residual equation remains as printed/labelled in the source, without silently resolving its sign/parenthesis ambiguity.

required_coverage.population: Compustat annual firm-years with sufficient Jones-model raw fields in the source SIC-year fitting universe; exact company coverage and cell inclusion beyond the stated minimum size are not locally confirmed.
required_coverage.detail: Residual outcomes and cell coefficients are contemporaneous for 1988–2000. Net-sales change and average-assets scaling each require t−1, so the raw annual envelope begins in 1987.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels align semantically: oiadp is operating income after depreciation; oancf is operating-activities net cash flow; sale is net sales/turnover; ppent is net PP&E; at is total assets; and sich is historical SIC. This uses field labels and source definitions, not historical item-number resemblance. Residual arithmetic is a separate unresolved source-specification issue.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact fields are present; no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes historical coverage or the fitting universe.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Exact fields are verified, but the local file has no coordinator-confirmed 1987–2000 support-population coverage. The article’s printed Discretionary Accrual expression is not consistent with its Jones-residual description.

Preserve this cell-fit universe before the later baseline tenure/first-year screens; the source does not specify every preliminary filter that defines eligible fit rows.

required_coverage.frequency: annual two-digit-SIC-by-year fitting cells and firm-year observations
required_coverage.population: Broad Compustat firm-year fitting cells with the stated minimum of eight firms and sufficient model fields; retain a pre-final-baseline population because the paper estimates residuals contemporaneously and later describes separate auditor-duration/first-year regression screens. Exact preliminary cell filters are not stated.
required_coverage.detail: The dependent/residual years are 1988–2000. Each fitted model uses t and t−1 net sales and average assets, hence raw fields start in 1987. The cell-size denominator is at least eight firms within each SIC-year; it is not the 41,250 final baseline regression N or a tenure-screened denominator.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: The raw field labels support the named fit inputs and identifiers. OLS-by-SIC-year and the eight-firm minimum are paper-specified fit design; a column probe cannot verify the number of firms in historical cells or full support-population coverage.
routes.coverage_notes: Fields are present, but neither historical cell population nor full 1987–2000 coverage is coordinator-confirmed; no row-count inference is made from the bounded probe.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No local coverage confirmation verifies the broad eligible firm-year population, historical cell sizes, or source-vintage filters. The fit must not be reduced to later 41,250-row regression samples.

requirements.description: Firm-year history used for the paper’s requirement of at least six years of prior Compustat data before sample observations; this is an eligibility screen distinct from the outcome/control transformation windows.

required_coverage.population: Firm identifiers in the initial Compustat sample and six preceding annual years needed to determine prior-data availability; exact completeness criterion for each prior year is not further specified.
required_coverage.detail: The selected main period begins in 1988 and requires six years prior; 1982–1987 is the earliest possible required history. Retain 1988–2000 target observations. This sample-history window is not added on top of variable transformation lags.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: GVKEY and annual fiscal-year/date fields identify firm-year records. routes.coverage_notes: Live identifiers and candidate accounting fields are present. No historical coverage confirmation establishes 1982–2000 completeness.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The paper requires six years of prior data but does not fully define the precise completeness test, and no local coverage confirmation verifies the relevant firm history.

requirements.description: Firm-year M&A exclusion using the Compustat footnote codes specified by the paper and attributed to Collins and Hribar (2002). The exact Compustat code variable/table and code values are not identified in the assigned source.

required_coverage.population: All initial eligible Compustat firm-years considered for the 1988–2000 sample before multivariate regression; exact screen field/code population is not specified.
required_coverage.detail: The screen operates on the paper’s fiscal-year observations in 1988–2000. routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: acqmeth is labeled Acquisition Method, aqc Acquisitions and aqs Acquisitions—Sales Contribution. These exact fields are present, but the article only identifies Compustat footnote codes and does not say these candidate fields implement that rule. Mapping is unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: The candidate columns are live; there is no source-field crosswalk, historical/population coverage confirmation, or validated M&A code mapping.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The source does not identify the Compustat footnote-code field(s) or values used for the M&A exclusion. Candidate acquisition fields are present but cannot be treated as the cited footnote codes; local historical coverage is also unconfirmed.

requirements.description: Firm-to-auditor annual relationship history needed to calculate consecutive auditor tenure, identify first engagement years, determine full auditor-client relationship duration of at least five years, and continue tenure across audit-firm mergers. The source does not bound the start/end of the relationship history or identify the exact firm/auditor link source.

required_coverage.frequency: annual firm–auditor relationship history, with engagement and merger dates where needed
required_coverage.population: All auditor-client combinations represented in 1988–2000 baseline firm-years, including sufficient history before the observed years and any later history needed to determine whether total relationship length reaches five years.
required_coverage.detail: A finite raw interval cannot be set: tenure is cumulative from an unspecified relationship start, and the screen retains every available year only when the full relationship lasts at least five years, which can require follow-up beyond 2000. The source provides no first/last observation bounds.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current local vintage)
routes.mapping_notes: The live COMP.FUNDA fields are labeled Global Company Key, Data Date, Data Year—Fiscal, Auditor and Rank—Auditor. The paper requires auditor-firm merger continuity and complete client relationship histories, but the field probe does not establish auditor code continuity, engagement start/stop dates, merger links, or firm-to-auditor identifier validity. Mapping and identifiers remain unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact fields are present in the current annual table, but neither the complete relationship universe nor its pre/post-period history is coverage-confirmed.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The source requires consecutive-year tenure, merger continuations and a total-duration screen, but gives no link source, merger crosswalk, history start or follow-up endpoint. Current AU/RANK fields alone do not establish these histories.

Source says the grouping changes with large-firm mergers and describes Big N as the largest number of major firms considered, without enumerating the year-specific members.

required_coverage.population: The paper’s Compustat firm-years in 1988–2000 with an auditor code and a year-specific Big N classification.
required_coverage.detail: Baseline indicator values are aligned to annual firm-year observations from 1988–2000. The field presence is verified, but source-to-code categories, annual group membership and merger-year transitions are not.

routes.coverage_notes: Exact auditor fields are present, but source population coverage and the year-specific classification are not coordinator-confirmed.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Local COMP.FUNDA has live auditor code fields but no confirmed historical coverage or validated year-by-year Big N lookup. The paper does not specify the exact list or merger transitions.

requirements.description: Annual cross-sectional distributions used to delete the top and bottom 0.5% of operating cash flow, Current Accruals and Jones-model residuals. required_coverage.frequency: annual cross-sectional percentile distributions over firm-year observations

required_coverage.detail: Tail cutoffs are calculated separately within each year (not across a rolling window). routes.coverage_notes: Fields are present, but no historical coverage confirmation verifies the annual input populations or pre-tenure per-year distributions.

variable_coverage.construction: Jones-model residual derived from the contemporaneous SIC-year OLS support fit; absolute value. Consecutive years the firm retained the auditor, with audit-firm-merger changes continued as the prior auditor. Requires an issuer–auditor history with unbounded source endpoints; the same full relationship history determines the ≥5-year eligibility and first-engagement-year exclusion.
Age is the number of years total assets is reported in Compustat since 1980; count annual at observations through year t.
Size is log(total assets) for the firm-year; use at_t.

Industry Growth is the ratio of aggregate sales in the current year to aggregate prior-year sales within two-digit SIC, as transcribed from the paper; no subtraction of one is shown. Keep the prior-year annual industry denominator separate from any per-year trimming population.
Cash Flow is operating cash flow divided by average total assets; use oancf_t / mean(at_t, at_t−1).
Indicator 1 for a Big N auditor and 0 otherwise. Source says the definition varies with mergers and gives no year-specific auditor membership list; AU/RANK live fields are candidate raw codes only.

Supporting contemporaneous industry-year OLS outcome: operating income after depreciation minus operating cash flow, scaled by average total assets. No coefficients are observed columns; coefficients are estimated within each two-digit SIC × year cell, with cells under eight firms excluded.

evidence.quote: Our initial sample consists of all firm-years from 1988 to 2000 inclusive with sufficient data on the 2001 Compustat annual industrial and research files to estimate accruals.
evidence.description: Original Compustat source vintage and 1988–2000 firm-year sample.

evidence.quote: In addition, we require at least the six years of prior data to ensure that any abnormal accruals behavior associated with start-up firms
evidence.description: Six-year prior-data sample screen.

evidence.quote: To identify firms that undergo mergers and acquisitions, we follow Collins and Hribar (2002) and use the footnote codes appearing in Compustat.
evidence.description: M&A exclusions use Compustat footnote codes; exact code fields are not named.

evidence.quote: We calculate auditor tenure as the number of years that the firm has retained the given auditor, and code auditor changes attributable to audit firm mergers as a continuation of the prior auditor.
evidence.description: Tenure accumulation and audit-firm-merger continuation rule.

evidence.quote: We determine which observations are in the top or bottom 0.5 percent of the distribution of cash flow from operations, Current Accruals or Jones Model residuals annually and delete them to remove outliers.
evidence.description: Annual cross-sectional tail trimming; this is not described as a rolling time window.

evidence.quote: when the auditor-client relationship lasts at least five years, we retain all available observations, and when the auditor-client relationship lasts for less than five years, we eliminate all of these auditor-client observations.
evidence.description: Relationship-duration screen is based on total relationship length and keeps all available years.

evidence.quote: we eliminate the first year of the audit in all of our multivariate tests.
evidence.description: First auditor-engagement year omitted from multivariate analyses.

evidence.quote: We estimate the residuals and the coefficients contemporaneously. That is, for each year, we estimate the model within two-digit SIC industries, and use the residuals from this regression as our estimate of discretionary accruals.
evidence.description: Jones residuals and coefficients are fitted contemporaneously within year and two-digit SIC.

evidence.quote: coefficient estimates from an OLS regression by industry-year, where an industry is defined by its two-digit SIC code; to reduce sampling error and to be consistent with prior literature, we eliminate industry-years with fewer than eight firms;
evidence.description: Supporting Jones coefficient fits are OLS by SIC-year with a minimum cell size of eight firms.

evidence.quote: We scale all variables by average total assets.
evidence.description: Scale for accrual, revenue and PPE measures; average assets adds the preceding fiscal-year value.

evidence.quote: Accruals - operating income after depreciation (Compustat annual data item 178) - cash flow from operations (Compustat annual data item 108);
evidence.description: Jones-model raw input definitions and cited historical Compustat items.

evidence.quote: CA - change in current assets (Compustat annual data item 4); - Cash - change in cash and cash equivalents (Compustat annual date item 1);
evidence.description: Current-accrual component definitions; the original reading OCRs the displayed formula imperfectly.

evidence.quote: CL - change in current liabilities (Compustat annual data item 5); - STD - change in short-term notes and current portion of long-term debt (Compustat annual data item 34);
evidence.description: Remaining current-accrual component definitions.

evidence.quote: Age - the number of years for which total assets was reported in Compustat since 1980; Size - the log of total assets;
evidence.description: Age and Size definitions.

evidence.quote: Cash Flow - the firm’s cash flow from operations divided by average total assets; Auditor Type - an indicator set to 1 if the auditor is a Big N Auditor, and set to 0
evidence.description: Cash Flow and Auditor Type definitions.

evidence.quote: This measure varies with mergers of the large accounting firms; the Big N is the largest number of major accounting firms considered.
evidence.description: The Big N indicator changes across audit-firm mergers, but the group list is not specified.

evidence.quote: Industry - a control based on two-digit SIC codes (62 industries); and Year - a control for calendar year.
evidence.description: Two-digit SIC and calendar-year fixed-effect definitions.

evidence.quote: Accruals = alpha + beta_1*Tenure + beta_2*Age + beta_3*Size + beta_4*IndustryGrowth + beta_5*CashFlow + beta_6*AuditorType + beta_7-69*Industry + beta_1988-1999*Year + epsilon.
evidence.description: Coordinator-verified transcription of the displayed main equation; the year coefficient range is printed as 1988–1999.

evidence.quote: Here we use a truncated regression approach because the ordinary least squares (OLS) estimates are generally biased toward zero when a sample is truncated. Thus, we estimate a maximum likelihood truncated regression model to arrive at an unbiased coefficient on Tenure.
evidence.description: Sign-specific outcomes are estimated by maximum-likelihood truncated regression.

evidence.quote: Each cell contains a coefficient estimate and p-values in square brackets.
evidence.description: Reported inference contains p-values; standard-error method is not given.
